Validation of ign_IC4H8_1_3

Thermodynamic conditions

  • Temperature, $T$: 1441.0 K
  • Pressure, $p$ : 1.7 atm
  • Equivalence Ratio, $\phi$: 0.5
  • Mixture Composition, $X$: 1.72% IC4H8-20.65% O2-77.63% AR

Experimental measurement

  • Source: experimental data from (TX)-ZLO2016
  • Data type: Shock tube ignition delay measurement
  • Experimental method: max grad pres
  • Experimental value: 240.0 $\mu s$
  • Experimental uncertainty: $ \times / \div$ 1.5

Model predictions

  • Trial model prediction: 254.79 $\mu s$
  • Trial model uncertainty: $ \times / \div$ 1.09
  • Optimized model prediction: 242.0 $\mu s$
  • Optimized model uncertainty: $ \times / \div$ 1.05
